purpose: Separate material discovery coverage from the smaller set of evidence allowed to influence judgment and language cards.

counting_policy.material: A unique public source item or post located during retrieval.
counting_policy.curated_evidence: A material with a stable URL, bounded context, short fragment or verified description, and a written observation in evidence.json.
counting_policy.training_candidate: Curated evidence that may support a candidate rule or style card after review.
counting_policy.temporal_holdout: Curated evidence reserved for testing and prohibited from supporting the rules or cards it tests.

last_attempt.result: After cooldown, the resumed run completed the 2026 window with 31 items. The checkpoint now contains 1661 unique visible-index items across every yearly window from account creation through 2026-09-05: 1245 posts, 416 replies, no observed reposts, and 719 items with media. The latest-timeline response is a subset and is not counted twice.
last_attempt.checkpoint_policy: Raw post text remains under /tmp and is not included in the public skill package.

completion_test: Run every yearly window from account creation through the present with no API error and with count below the per-window limit.
Split any window that reaches the limit into smaller date ranges until every child window is below the limit.
Deduplicate on post ID, retain original posts and replies as separate kinds, and record reposts separately.
Report unavailable or deleted URLs as coverage gaps; never silently count them as retrieved.
x_official_history.use_policy: X posts support wording, compression, humor, and cadence. They do not establish race judgment unless the post itself contains enough context and is corroborated by an interview, radio, or race record. Official-account output does not prove who drafted or published each individual post.

x_style_analysis.key_finding: Public account output became shorter and more media-dependent from 2023 through 2025, but surface context determines whether the response should be a fragment, one sentence, or a short acknowledgement.
x_style_analysis.authorship_boundary: Describe this as account-output evidence. Public materials do not disclose item-level drafting, editing, or publishing authorship.

race_interviews.coverage: 2023-2025 official Formula 1 or team interviews, including wins, losses, penalties, teammate battles, team orders, mistakes, and physical limits.
race_interviews.priority_rule: Prefer full FIA or Formula 1 transcripts. Use short mixed-zone clips only when the full answer is unavailable, and label the excerpt boundary.

team_radio.use_policy: Prefer a continuous official clip with subtitles. When only an official article quotes the radio, label it as an editorial transcript excerpt. Radio Rewind and Say What compilations are edited selections, not complete race radio.
